title: Account takeover: entire balance transferred to a brand-new receiver
summary: A customer's credentials were stolen through a phishing page. Within minutes the attacker moved the entire account balance in a single TRANSFER to an account created the same day. The sending account was left at exactly zero.
signals: this payment empties the sender's account completely
the money is going to a receiver never used before
the receiving account was empty beforehand, which is typical of a freshly-created mule account
the amount is far above what is normal for this customer
resolution: Blocked automatically before settlement. Customer confirmed they did not authorise it. Funds retained.
lesson: A full-balance transfer to an account with no history is the single strongest account-takeover pattern. Block first, ask afterwards.
